rationale: A repeatedly reorients to salient events and objects: responds to TOUCH by leaning to PERSON_ALPHA (t=8–17), orients to CALL (t=20–24), shifts to OFFER_FOOD (t=32–41), attends PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t=44–53), and shows a sustained STARTLE response (t=68–77). A also makes sensible spontaneous shifts (e.g., to PLAY_MIRROR t=18–19, PLAY_CHIME t=30–31, PLAY_CUBE t=54–65, PERSON_ALPHA t=94–95). B responds to TOUCH, OFFER_FOOD, and STARTLE (t=8–11, 32–35, 68–71) but ignores CALL (remains on PLAY_BALL at t=20–31) and ignores PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (stays gaze NONE at t=44–47), then remains largely gaze NONE for long spans (t=40–67, 72–95). Overall, A shows greater connectedness to inputs, richer spontaneous-yet-sensible activity, and more continuous, adaptive engagement.
